method: Reconcile all 210 initially untyped concepts against the existing Lotto05 proposals. Flag 8 semantic revisions and 8 further ambiguity cases based on labels and work/context distinction; these are editorial proposals, NOT external cataloguing certification. Carry over all other 194 as provisional. Separately review catalogue admission conditions for the 14 previously sourced lexical candidates, with 5 targeted source rechecks. Morricone is an additional qualified candidate, not a new legacy graph edge.
